title: Preference file front matter
description: The front matter of one preference file in preferences/ (#2771): a default a person or team chose, weaker than a constraint. The Markdown body after the front matter is free-form detail. Values stay within what YAML and JSON share.

schema.description: Format version of this file. Bumped only by a change to this schema.

id.description: Stable id: a lowercase prefix, a dash and three or more digits. Never reused, never renumbered.

title.description: Short topic: what the preference is about, in a few words.

state.description: proposed: written, not yet the default. active: it is the default. withdrawn: it no longer is. Sealed once reached. Nothing here stops a decision from overriding the preference in one place without withdrawing it.

source.description: Where the preference was first recorded: a row of an issue's table, the workspace itself when no issue holds it, or a harness session when neither does. Each form may also say where the proposal came from: the fields via, client, harness, model, session, turns and transcript.

default.description: The default itself, stated so a later reader can follow it without the discussion behind it.

rationale.description: Why this is the default. Null when nobody wrote one down.

proposed_by.description: Who proposed this preference: the name chant workspace records new --by or the MCP records-new tool's by wrote, for a preference that opened proposed (#2756). Null or absent when nobody named a proposer, or the preference opened straight into a later state. Never cleared once the preference is chosen or withdrawn.

chosen_by.description: Who chose the default: a person's forge login, or a team name. Null while proposed.

chosen_on.description: When the default was chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD. Quoted, so YAML reads it as a string. Null while proposed.

evidence.description: The discussion and workspace files behind the preference. A public link carries a url; a file in the workspace carries a path and the hash of its bytes (#2549). May be empty.

workspacePath.description: A path from the workspace root, with / separators: no leading /, no . or .. segment, no empty segment, no backslash and no trailing /.

as_of.description: When the linked text was read, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Lets a reader flag evidence that changed afterwards.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the linked content, once evidence is pinned by hash (#2555). Null until then.

evidencePin.description: A file in the workspace, pinned by the hash of its bytes. chant workspace records reports a file that changed or went missing since.

path.description: The file, from the workspace root. It sits inside a member, such as design/screens/home.json.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes when the preference was written. chant workspace records pin <path> prints it.

as_of.description: When the file was read, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

sourceIssue.description: A row of a table in an issue.

row.description: The row's topic cell, verbatim, including any revision marker.

revision.description: The design revision that last changed this row, such as "v8". Null when the row carries no marker.

sourceWorkspace.description: A preference chosen in the workspace, with no issue behind it.

member.description: The workspace member the preference came from, by its name in the declaration.

session.description: The id of the session the preference came from, as the member names it, or the harness's session with the chant session record it was held in. Null or absent when there was none.

issue.description: An issue the preference relates to, when there is one.

sourceHarness.description: A preference proposed in a harness session, with no issue row or workspace member behind it. It says how it arrived, in via, and may say the rest of where the proposal came from.

issue.description: An issue the preference relates to, when there is one.

sourceVia.description: How the record reached the workspace: cli, a person or script at chant workspace records new; mcp, a harness through chant serve mcp, which fills this and client itself; harvest, a transcript read after the fact. Data about the proposal, not trust.

sourceClient.description: What wrote the record: the MCP client's clientInfo, or the CLI.

sourceHarnessId.description: The harness the preference was proposed in, such as claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, opencode, fountain or hud.

sourceModel.description: The model id the harness reports.

sourceSession.description: The session the preference was proposed in: its id as a string, or an object with the harness's session or conversation id and the chant session record it was held in. Null when there was none.

id.description: The harness's session or conversation id.

record.description: The id of the chant session record the preference was held in.

sourceTurns.description: The turns of the session the preference was made in, from and to, counted as the harness counts them. to is not before from.

sourceTranscript.description: The session's transcript, pinned by a path or URI and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of its bytes, never copied into the record. A path is absolute, starts ~/ from the home directory, or starts at the workspace root; of URIs, only file: ones are read.
